title: SmartAttend Official Release (v1.0.4)
releaseNotes: Classroom attendance waits up to 15 seconds for an accurate live GPS fix.
The lecturer GPS display shows when device accuracy is outside the 45m requirement.
GPS recalibration and geofence updates require a fresh accurate location.
Update reminders stay dismissed after refreshing or reopening the app.
Fingerprint enrollment now reports when its Firebase backend is unavailable.
Android and iOS face API origins are explicitly allowed.
New attendance sessions default to 45 seconds plus 75 seconds.
Quick attendance preset is now 30 seconds plus 30 seconds.
Official Release of SmartAttend with modern glassmorphism UI
Streamed In-App Update system with SHA-256 integrity checks
Step-by-step Android installation and source permission guidance
Real-time attendance management and student verification
